name: Uzuki Aina
source:
A girl belonging to the cheerlanding club.
A bright and simple-minded kind of character. If she sees someone being bothered, she will absolutely try to help as she has a pure (and a bit naive) heart. The MC encountered her when he was feeling down, and she encouraged him to feel better. Since then, every time they meet again, her voice would cheer him.
